cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep this envelope out of Mum's sight. Flat in your coat pocket, please; don't fold it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I tell her you asked me to take it home?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. A handover isn't a family announcement. Just take your coat with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's coming in. She'll ask why I'm wearing it at the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Over your arm, then. With the pocket facing you. Let me do the talking.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects public disclosure and A5 corrects coat handling to maintain A1's secret handover.

responseLogic.evidence: B4's coat-at-table concern causes A5's over-arm handling, but B2's offer to announce ownership strains A1's explicit concealment request.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks to disclose after A1 expressly said to keep it out of Mum's sight; without a stated competing concern this risks a conveniently foolish helper.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes how B will carry the coat after B4 identifies conspicuous wearing.
